walkthroughs.body_html:
HL Regional Option: History of the Americas — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

HL Regional Option: History of the Americas brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with HL Regional Option: History of the Americas.

mcqs.q: Which Bolshevik slogan summarised Lenin's April Theses?
options: Peace, Land, Bread
Workers of the world unite
Liberte, egalite, fraternite
Better dead than red

mcqs.q: What was the immediate cause of the February Revolution?
options: German invasion
Bread shortages in Petrograd
Lenin's return from Switzerland
Kerensky's offensive

mcqs.q: Why was Vesalius significant in the history of medicine?
options: Vesalius invented the microscope.
His 1543 De Humani Corporis Fabrica corrected Galen's errors via human dissection and accurate illustration, founding modern anatomy though not curing disease.
Vesalius discovered the cause of disease and ended humoral theory.
Lincoln ended segregation by signing the 14th Amendment.

mcqs.q: How was the US civil rights movement achieved?
options: Vesalius invented the microscope.
Martin Luther King's 'I Have a Dream' speech ended segregation.
Through decades of mass organising — NAACP legal work, grassroots campaigns, sit-ins, freedom rides — alongside leaders like King and Malcolm X.
Lincoln ended segregation by signing the 14th Amendment.

mcqs.q: Why did Lenin introduce the NEP in 1921?
options: Lincoln ended segregation by signing the 14th Amendment.
War Communism had collapsed the economy and provoked the Kronstadt revolt; the NEP allowed limited private trade to restore production and stabilise Bolshevik rule.
The NEP was Lenin's plan to permanently switch Russia to capitalism.
The NEP was introduced by Stalin to fund the Five-Year Plans.
